verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a probe saying an official CLI is documented on the install page. That page's listed install options (Homebrew, binaries, DEB/RPM packages) appear to describe distribution of the server itself, not a client CLI for managing collections and data. Missing for 10: any documentation of the CLI's commands or capabilities, evidence it supports scripted or agent-driven workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its use.
